results.title: Call for Solutions: Fog Tester Analysis Software Application
unknowns: Federal/SAM/CAGE eligibility and any foreign-entity participation constraints are not conclusively resolved in the exposed DCE evidence.
Authoritative submission deadline remains semantically unresolved.
SPM must be able to satisfy DoD software-assurance deliverables including SAST, SCA, SBOM, ASD STIG checklist, remediation/POA&M and source/build reproducibility.

results.why: Direct custom software fit: standalone Windows image-analysis application, Python/.NET/LabVIEW accepted, data analysis, calibration logic and source-code delivery. It is commercially interesting, but DoD software-assurance and bidder-eligibility gates remain material UNKNOWNs.

results.title: Inventory Management Software
unknowns: Federal/SAM/CAGE and any set-aside or foreign-entity eligibility constraints need final confirmation.
Past-performance minimums and scoring thresholds must be resolved from the solicitation instructions.
Local ATO, DISA STIG and ongoing IAVA/security-patch obligations must be demonstrably supportable.

results.why: Very strong direct software scope: custom development is explicitly allowed, requirement is software/support only, localized to one team with roughly 10 users and up to 100k items, CSV migration, business-hours support, no 24/7 requirement and no post-UAT consulting requirement. Security and federal eligibility keep it below GREEN for now.
